dimensions.note: No credential surface changed, and the #436 Deno.Command finding is a reviewed false positive. runRestic (the only subprocess) throws if password or secretAccessKey appears in any argv element, passes RESTIC_PASSWORD / AWS_* only through env with clearEnv:true, spawns without a shell, and redacts both secrets from stderr. Covered by the existing tests 'runRestic refuses a credential passed in argv', 'credentials travel in the environment, and argv stays clean', 'clearEnv keeps unrelated parent variables out', and mechanical check #5. The new --include argument is derived from the path input and goes through the same argv secret scan. Accepted with an inline swamp-quality-ignore deno-command comment carrying the reason.
File mode logs one info line naming the file, the parent selector and the include before the second dry run; the completion line is unchanged. Nothing sensitive is logged.

Keeps write-then-throw and the fail-closed ceiling. A file path's 'not a directory' refusal (live 2026-10-20) is detected on stderr or stdout and retried as parent + anchored --include; that dry run goes through the same ceiling. An include matching nothing yields a bare summary and stays size-unmeasurable (refused); one matching more than one file is refused as file-match-mismatch. A snapshot or dump path beginning with '-' is a call error thrown before restic runs.

152 tests across extensions/ and reviews/ pass (deno test -A, exit 0). New: fileRestorePlan, escapeIncludePattern, estimatedRestoreBytes, isNotADirectory unit tests; single-file restore under the ceiling (argv sequence asserted); single file over the ceiling never runs a real restore; include matching nothing refused; include matching two refused; directory path never gains --include; flag-like snapshot/dump path refused before restic runs; and an end-to-end test against a real restic binary and a throwaway local repository (skipped when restic is absent) proving anchoring (sub/counts.json not pulled), glob escaping, and the empty-file summary. Mutations: dropping --include, disabling the flag guard, disabling the match-count guard, disabling escaping, and dropping the empty-file rule each fail the suite; disabling file detection fails type-check.
Still read-only: the extra call is a --dry-run restore under the --no-lock injection. A file path costs one extra dry run (the refused one) before the real restore.

restic semantics measured on 0.19.1 against a local scratch repository: '<snap>:<file>' fails exit_error 'path …: not a directory' on stderr; '<snap>:<parent> --include /<name>' restores only that file to <target>/<name> and does not match a nested same-named file; restic glob metacharacters are escaped with backslash; an empty file's summary omits total_bytes (omitempty) but reports total_files; an include matching nothing yields a bare summary.
No new handles. The e2e test creates its repository in a Deno temp dir removed in finally; fake-restic logs are removed in finally.
Fixtures use /srv/app/... and /etc paths and the suite's placeholder host; no internal host, bucket, vault or tailnet names. The pre-push denylist hook is the second gate.
No resource schema change. failureReason gains the value file-match-mismatch (it is a plain string). RestoreArgsSchema.path description updated only.
No new spec; lifetime and garbageCollection unchanged.
No new check; the flag guard needs method inputs, which checks never receive, so it lives in execute.
No new instance names; file mode writes validation-restore like any restore.

Model version bumped 2026.08.07.2 -> 2026.10.22.1 (= swamp extension version nextVersion; manifest matches) with a no-op upgrades entry: every globalArguments change since 2026.08.07 only added optional fields (excludeTags, transportRetryDelaySeconds), so existing arguments are valid unchanged; the entry advances typeVersion so no instance is stranded. Resolves #435 for this extension: the versionBumpUpgrade warning is absent from push --dry-run, and present when the entry is removed (negative control).
